initiatives.name: Capital Allocation and Financing Strategy
initiatives.summary: IHG secured a new $1,500 million syndicated credit facility and successfully removed financial covenants from the previous facility. This strengthened the Group's financial resilience and liquidity profile.

evidence.title: New $950m share buyback programme
evidence.summary: The Board approved a new $950 million share buyback programme for 2026, following the completion of a $900 million buyback programme in 2025. Combined with dividend payments of $270 million, this represents over $1.1 billion in returns to shareholders.
evidence.quote: New $950m share buyback programme approved for 2026.

evidence.title: New $1.5bn syndicated credit facility
evidence.summary: IHG secured a new $1,500 million syndicated credit facility and successfully removed financial covenants from the previous facility. This strengthened the Group's financial resilience and liquidity profile.
evidence.quote: We secured a new $1,500m syndicated credit facility and successfully removed the financial covenants associated with the previous facility.

evidence.title: €850 million bond issuance
evidence.summary: The Board supported and approved an €850 million bond issuance as part of strengthening the Group's financial resilience and liquidity profile. This represents a significant debt financing initiative.
evidence.quote: The Board also supported the strengthening of the Group's financial resilience and liquidity profile through approval of an €850 million bond issuance

initiatives.name: Global Efficiency Programme
initiatives.summary: IHG implemented a global efficiency programme as part of its cost reduction and operational efficiency initiatives. The programme resulted in $21 million in operating exceptional costs in 2025 and contributed to fee margin expansion through operational leverage and cost efficiencies.

initiatives.name: Hotel Energy Conservation Programme
initiatives.summary: IHG implemented 18 hotel energy conservation measures to increase energy efficiency and reduce costs for owners. This achieved a 10.2% reduction in energy per available room and 11.0% reduction in carbon per available room compared to 2019 baseline.

evidence.title: 18 hotel energy conservation measures implemented

evidence.quote: 18 hotel energy conservation measures now in place to increase energy efficiency and reduce costs for owners. – 10.2% reduction in energy per available room and a 11.0% reduction in carbon per available room compared with 2019 baseline.

initiatives.name: High-Performance Culture Initiative
initiatives.summary: IHG launched a 'High Performance Culture' initiative for corporate and reservations colleagues globally, introducing new performance management approaches, enhanced reward differentiation, and strengthened leadership capabilities through Journey to General Manager and other development programmes.

initiatives.name: Ruby Hotel Brand Acquisition
initiatives.summary: IHG acquired Ruby as its 20th brand, providing owners with a flexible city concept. The acquisition included 6,741 rooms (36 hotels), with 5,718 rooms (30 hotels) part of the initial agreement and the first 2,952 Ruby rooms (17 hotels) joining IHG's system during the year.
